title: Your garden of milestones & badges
description: Badges are not a race for achievement. They are little blossoms that celebrate the care you give yourself and the world each day.

stats.warmth: A little warmth, nurtured every day
stats.positive: A little more room for the good
stats.encouragement: You’re doing well! Just {count} more days until you reach The Persistent Sprout badge.

philosophy.title: Finding your rhythm, without comparison
philosophy.subtitle: The thinking behind BeGrateful
philosophy.body: At BeGrateful, badges are never a leaderboard. If a busy day passes without writing, you haven’t failed. You’re simply living your life. The Gratitude That Returns badge will always be here to welcome you back.

inspiration.title: A seed of inspiration
inspiration.quote: “Sáng nay ngắm nhìn chiếc mầm nhỏ vừa bung lá sau mưa, mình chợt thấy biết ơn vì mình vẫn ở đây, khỏe mạnh và bình yên.”
inspiration.author: Mai Nhã (Ẩn danh)
inspiration.alt: An open journal beside a warm cup of tea in gentle sunlight

cta.title: Tend to your own little garden
cta.description: Three minutes of gratitude each day can bring a little calm to your inner world.

1.title: The First Sprout

1.description: Write your first gratitude entry and plant a seed of peace.

2.title: A Steady Rhythm
2.subtitle: Golden lotus • 3-day streak
2.description: Three consecutive days of writing: a gentle first step toward a daily practice.

3.title: A Peaceful Blossom
3.subtitle: Five-petal ceramic seal • 7-day streak
3.description: A full week of nurturing kindness, like a blossom opening in your heart.

4.title: The Jade Lotus
4.subtitle: Layered jade glaze • 14-day streak
4.description: Fourteen days of stillness, like a lotus blooming on a quiet lake.

5.title: Gratitude That Returns
5.subtitle: Jade leaf • Habit
5.description: Return after a busy spell and welcome your own pace with kindness.
5.condition: Return to writing after a busy day

6.title: Finding the Good
6.subtitle: Daisy seal • Habit
6.description: Notice three things to be grateful for and discover wonder in the everyday.
6.condition: Write 3 meaningful gratitudes in a day

7.title: The Persistent Sprout

7.description: Twenty-one days to make gratitude feel as natural as breathing.

8.title: A Flourishing Plant
8.subtitle: Jade planter • 30-day streak
8.description: A whole month of tending your inner garden, growing greener every day.

9.title: Welcoming the Dawn

10.title: Seeds of Kindness
10.subtitle: Sandstone dandelion • Community
10.description: Share five anonymous entries to bring warmth to someone else’s day.

11.title: The Tree Within
11.subtitle: Carved marble • 100-day streak
11.description: A hundred days of gratitude, growing the strength to weather life’s storms.

12.title: A Longer Journey
12.subtitle: Mindfulness compass • 365 days
12.description: Let gratitude become a way of life through all four seasons.
